Also read docs/design/NAVIGATION_INFORMATION_ARCHITECTURE.md section 6.3 (shared entity workspace context) and project/roadmap.json's own M11 upcoming-row note ('One selected entity across modules... Prerequisite M10'). Do not restate these documents -- they are this movement's complete design authority; this SESSION_START only points to them.

AC-2: before writing any code, confirm the CURRENT real state in a short RELAY_NOTE: (a) which resolver stages/producers M10.1/M10.2/M10.3 actually shipped (D2/D3/D4 producers, resolver core stages 0-3) and whether any caller/UI/payload builder currently consumes them at all -- CURRENT_STATE.md's M3 predecessor section claims 'none wired to a caller/UI/payload yet, so every dimension still resolves UNKNOWN in any actual render'; verify this against the actual code, don't just trust the doc; (b) exactly which of the four availability_rule predicates (P1-P4) the existing NAV.1 prototype already implements (the doc says only the P1 shell-integrity conjunct) and which this movement must add; (c) whether a shared-entity-workspace-context mechanism exists anywhere today (grep static/navigation_ui.js and friends) or this is greenfield. AC-3: implement the D1-driven availability_rule wiring -- connect the M10 resolver's stage 0 (union tag) output as the sole input to each navigation entry/tab's render-or-not decision, closing predicates P2 (entity applicability) and P3 (evidence state) at minimum (P4 future authorization stays out of scope -- no authorization/RBAC model exists yet, D7/M14 territory). AC-4: implement AC-CS-2's own regression test: a cross-product test proving D2..D7 varying (including a contradiction-class case) produces zero change in which entries/tabs render, with D1 alone controlling that decision.

AC-5: implement shared entity workspace context per NAVIGATION_INFORMATION_ARCHITECTURE.md section 6.3 -- one selected entity persists across module navigation (e.g. selecting a device in Inventory keeps that same device selected when the user moves to Configuration/Compliance/Operations), using the existing hash/localStorage route model already in place (routes_preserved criterion, already done) rather than inventing a second state mechanism.

AC-6: no change to any dimension's own producer (D2/D3/D4 stay exactly as M10 shipped them), no new placeholder/disabled-state UI pattern, no scope creep into D5 (M12, blocked on M7/M8.3) or D7 (M14, blocked on DEPLOY.1A) -- both stay explicitly out of scope and must keep resolving UNKNOWN/POLICY_UNKNOWN exactly as today.

AC-7: targeted tests for the new wiring and the shared-entity-workspace mechanism, following tests/test_html_render_harness.py's and the existing NAV.1/M2 accessibility test style (real-Chromium browser assertions where the existing suite already uses them, not a new test harness).

AC-8: validation and state: targeted tests green; because this closes real criteria on an already-registered feature, update project/feature_registry.json (left_vertical_product_navigation: availability_rule criterion P2/P3 predicates -> done, noting P4 stays pending/out-of-scope), project/roadmap.json (M11 row: planned -> in_progress/done as appropriate), CURRENT_STATE.md and project/build_history.json in this PR; run the full one-shot regression once (DEV.TEST.1) since this touches shared navigation/rendering code paths.
